what: The heading art (text) is duplicated two more layers, screen-blended with red (accent) and blue (opposite color) 12px shadows, and for 1.35s every 5% it is sliced into horizontal bands (top/bottom 0~84%) that jump ±12~34px sideways, then fades out from 85% — the two layers jump in opposite directions. White scanlines flicker over it at .75 · .35 · .82… and shake ±5px. Once only.

options.on: /  load (default, right on attach) · scroll (when it enters 80% of screen) · event name (when that event reaches the document — after the entrance curtain fx:gate-open)
options.start: Start of on: scroll, default top 80%
options.--fx-glitch-a · --fx-glitch-b: Double-layer shadow color, default accent color · its opposite color
options.[data-fx-part=art]: Block to duplicate (first child if none)

from.where: index.html .sw-fv__catch — when the entrance curtain clears, the big hero copy breaks into red·blue strips and interlocks
